package generated

import machine "github.com/whitaker-io/machine/v4"

type Order struct {
	ID   string
	Seen int
}

func Poll() machine.EdgeFactory[Order] { return machine.Channel[Order](0) }

func Count(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order {
	out := f.Value()
	out.Seen++

	return out
}

func Interesting(f machine.Frame[Order]) bool { return f.Value().ID != "" }

func Store(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order { return f.Value() }
